budget_rule: at most three spec candidates per view, counting every --check run on a distinct spec
accounting_note: Attempts are assigned to the view whose subject they carried. The first candidate (specs/v1-provision.json, filenamed v1 by accident) drew the cp -> gRPC -> queue -> registry -> providers -> machines phase chain, i.e. the dispatch/provision subject that became v2; its raw check is attempts-raw/v1-a1-check.txt. The request view (final v1) therefore has three candidates and dispatch has three.
